from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star_coord = operator.StarWithCoordinator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.WORKER_COORD_DEGREE,
                prompt_custom.WORKER_COORD_CONSTRUCT,
                prompt_custom.WORKER_COORD_NO_CHECK,
                prompt_custom.WORKER_COORD_ENDPOINTS,
            ],
            coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.COORDINATOR_PATH_OR_NO,
            n_rounds=3,
        )
        solution = await star_coord(problem)
        return (solution.get("response") if solution else None) or "```\nNO\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
